headline: Nevish Line Turns Warden as Palantine Berm Fighting Mounts
war_summary: Nevish Line, deadlocked in the earlier edition, has swung sharply: six Warden positions now stand against one Colonial and one unclaimed, with fifty events reported in the day and two in the last two hours, Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal the busiest works. Palantine Berm, held wholly by the Wardens, has become the sharpest contest of the hour, its fifteen events in two hours and forty-seven in the day, Leiri Hermanni alone accounting for twenty-three. Weathered Expanse has yielded ground; three Warden posts face five Colonial with one vacant, after twenty-three events and losses running heavily against the defenders. Marban Hollow reports the bloodiest exchange, more than three thousand Warden and eighteen hundred Colonial casualties in two hours, leaving seven Colonial posts and one unclaimed. Kuura Strand, which erupted last edition, has quieted to a full six-post Warden hold. Callahan's Passage stands at eight Warden posts to two Colonial, its hourly loss rate still near five hundred a side, while Stlican Shelf has gone to eight Colonial against one Warden. No victor has been declared.
